sources.title: GitHub - haykgrigo3/TimeCapsuleLLM: A LLM trained only on data from ...
sources.snippet: TimeCapsule LLM A language model trained from scratch exclusively on data from certain places and time periods to reduce modern bias and emulate the voice, vocabulary, and worldview of the era. Imagine if an AI model didnt just pretend to be historical but actually was.
